scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.mkdirSync('dist', { recursive: true });"
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:js && npm run build:bundle
scripts.test:all: npm run build && npm run test:all-node && npm run test:ui
scripts.test:all-node: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:acceptance
scripts.test:unit: tsx --test src/tests/binary-heap.test.ts src/tests/combo-utils.test.ts src/tests/lru-cache.test.ts src/tests/utils.test.ts src/tests/services.test.ts src/tests/error-paths.test.ts
scripts.test:integration: tsx --test src/tests/integration.test.ts src/tests/integration-chart.test.ts src/tests/frontier-resumability.test.ts src/tests/prob-conservation.test.ts src/tests/tiered-aggregation.test.ts src/tests/worker-protocol.test.ts
scripts.test:acceptance: tsx --test src/tests/engine.test.ts src/tests/registry.test.ts src/tests/data-integrity.test.ts src/tests/enchantment_physical.test.ts src/tests/book_mechanics.test.ts src/tests/mechanics_rules.test.ts
scripts.test:ui: playwright test src/tests/ui-basic.test.ts src/tests/ui-performance.test.ts src/tests/ui-chart.test.ts src/tests/ui-regression.test.ts
scripts.release: npm run test:all && npm run build:standalone
